arguments.command:
python3 -c "
# Data extracted from Treasury bulletins:
# February 1942: 4.8% (from 1943_04_page_51.txt)

values = [4.8, 8.7, 9.6]
print(f'Values: {values}')

# Find the median
sorted_vals = sorted(values)
n = len(values)
if n % 2 == 1:
    median = sorted_vals[n // 2]
else:
    median = (sorted_vals[n // 2 - 1] + sorted_vals[n // 2]) / 2
print(f'Sorted: {sorted_vals}')
print(f'Median: {median}')

# Calculate absolute deviations from median
abs_deviations = [abs(v - median) for v in values]
print(f'Absolute deviations from median: {abs_deviations}')

# Mean deviation from median
mean_deviation = sum(abs_deviations) / len(abs_deviations)
print(f'Mean deviation from median: {mean_deviation}')

# Round to nearest thousandths
result = round(mean_deviation, 3)
print(f'Rounded to thousandths: {result}')
"
